subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

A group of ants
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** 'Colony'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A collective noun** is a noun that refers to some sort of group or collective—of people, animals, things, etc.
 
• Here we have to use a collective noun which can be used for** 'a group of ants'**.
 
• A **colony** refers to a group of ants.
 
 
• **For Example** - There is **a colony of ants** in the backyard.
 
 
 
• So, among the options the word which can be used as a collective noun for **'a group of ants'** is **'Colony'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: '**Colony'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the use of other collective nouns given:
 
 
• **'Bushel'** is used for a specific quantity of grains.

 
 
• **For Example** - A **bushel** of grain.
 
 
 
• **'Pack'** is used for a group of animals that move and hunt together.
 
 
• **For Example** - A **pack** of wolves.
 
 
 
• **'Comb'** is used a collective noun for bananas.
 
 
• **For Example **- A **comb** of bananas.
